_comment: Bus-count ramp, lot sizes, difficulty rhythm, twists and generator budgets. Levels 1-20 come from levels_authored.json. 'window' = how many buses the passenger queue serves at once (more = harder bay juggling).

sleep.title: Sleeping driver
sleep.text: Zzz... This driver dozed off. Tap once to wake them up, then tap again to drive.

cones.title: Roadwork
cones.text: Cones block the way! The road crew packs up after 3 buses have left.

covered.title: Umbrellas
covered.text: Some passengers hide under umbrellas. You see their colour when they reach the front.

tunnel.title: Tunnel
tunnel.text: Buses wait inside the tunnel. When one drives off, the next rolls out, always in the same order.
